discrepancies: Chart label 'Opus 3.5/4' for Jan-Jul 25: no Opus 3.5 exists in any fetched source. Jan-Apr 25 flagship is Claude 3 Opus (launched Mar 4, 2024) at $75 output, Opus 4 launched May 22, 2025 at $75. The $75 value is confirmed for Jan-Jul 25.

Chart Aug-Nov 25 at $15 (labelled Sonnet 4) is a tier switch, not a price cut. Opus 4.1 launched Aug 5, 2025 at $75 output and Opus stayed $75 until Opus 4.5 (Nov 24, 2025, $25). Sonnet 4/4.5 was $15 throughout. Flagship series should read $75 for Aug-Oct 25.
Nov 25: Opus 4.5 launched Nov 24, 2025 at $25. Month-end rule gives $25 for Nov 25; if the chart uses a first-full-month rule, Nov 25 stays $75 and $25 starts Dec 25 (matches the chart's idx 11).

Chart Dec 25 $25 'Opus 4.6 to 4.8' is confirmed at $25, but Opus 4.5 (Nov 24, 2025) is the model that carried $25 in Dec 25-Jan 26; Opus 4.6 launched Feb 5, 2026, 4.7 Apr 16, 2026, 4.8 May 28, 2026. All $25.
Chart Jun 26 'Fable 5.1' $50 is mislabelled: Fable 5 launched Jun 9, 2026 at $50. Fable 5.1 launched Sep 1, 2026, also $50. Price is correct, model name is not.

Chart omits Opus 5 (Jul 24, 2026, $25) and Opus 5.5 (Sep 22, 2026, $20). Opus is cheaper than Fable but its own price fell from $25 to $20 in Sep 26; an 'Opus' line is a separate series from the Fable flagship line from Jun 26.
Chart Nov 26 Fable 5.2 $40 is confirmed (launched Nov 9, 2026; $8 in / $40 out, down from $10 / $50). Live page and Wayback 20261111034421 and 20261116162854 agree.
gaps: Claude Mythos models (Mythos 5, 5.1, 5.2, Mythos Preview) are priced the same as Fable but are gated to Project Glasswing or verified organizations, so they are excluded as not generally available.

Launch dates were read from the live release notes (platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview) and cross-checked against official Anthropic pages in launch_corroboration_url: anthropic.com/news posts show Published dates for Opus 3, 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 4, Opus 4.1, Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5, Opus 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5; platform model pages show Released dates for Opus 4.5 to 5.5, Sonnet 4.5 to 5.5, Haiku 4.5, Haiku 5.5, Fable 5, 5.1, 5.2. All agree. Posts for Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 have no extractable publish date, so their dates rest on the model pages and release notes. No post slug was found for Fable 5.1 or 5.2 (docs pages used). Opus 4, Sonnet 4 and Haiku 3.5 launch dates (Nov 4, 2024 API availability for Haiku 3.5) come from release notes and the Claude 4 and Oct 2024 posts; Opus 3 from its Mar 4, 2024 post. Official posts also state the launch prices (Opus 4 $15/$75, Sonnet 4.5 $3/$15, Haiku 4.5 $1/$5, Opus 4.5 $5/$25, Opus 5.5 $4/$20, Sonnet 5 $2/$10 intro, Fable 5 $10/$50, Haiku 3.5 $0.80/$4).

Jan-Apr 2025 prices come from anthropic.com/pricing snapshots (20250101035229, 20250225010734, 20250303033321, 20250401052612), where cards are unlabelled JSON; models were matched by the names present on the page and the price sequence. Feb 25 also checked in 20250213035857. The docs.anthropic.com pricing page has no snapshot before 20250512.

Wayback coverage is a spot check: one snapshot per month used as source, plus weekly samples (days 1, 8, 15, 22, 29) fetched for Jun 2025 to Nov 2026 where retrievable (about 50 of 67 attempted). Several weekly fetches timed out. No intra-month price change appears between any two fetched snapshots, but a change inside an unfetched gap cannot be fully excluded.

Oct-Nov 2025 docs.claude.com snapshots were reached through Wayback redirects (final timestamps 20251008173016, 20251017134530, 20251112004600); a CDX listing for docs.claude.com could not be retrieved.
Haiku 5.5 has length-based pricing: $0.50 output up to 100,000-token prompts, $2.50 above. The point uses the up-to-100k rate; a long-context series would be $2.50.

Sonnet 5 was $10 output in Jul-Aug 26 as an introductory price with a scheduled increase to $15 on Sep 1, 2026 that was cancelled Aug 10, 2026 (release notes and snapshot 20260822034847); no month at $15 occurred.
Fast mode, priority tier, batch, caching and US-only inference (1.1x) premiums excluded by spec.
